rationale: Build on the best reverse recurrent-tail baseline with a minimal structural change: add learned per-tail anchor refresh gates so the decoder-output carry anchor can adapt after each recurrent block instead of staying frozen. This targets an underexplored recurrence/carry variant close to the strong local family, keeps shapes compile-stable, preserves the exact final int8+zlib evaluation path, and removes two lines elsewhere to stay under the 1500-line cap.
title: Reverse Tail Anchor Refresh
